about: The two editions of the FE Fates PC port, made from one commit by tools/release/package.py build --edition vanilla|seal (round 84, Seal edition split B; docs/SEAL_EDITION_PLAN.md sections 6 and 7). Paths are git paths (forward slashes). A folder ends in '/' and leaves out everything under it; any other entry is one exact file. Markers are the strong Seal of Flames words (never the bare word 'seal': Master Seal, Heart Seal and battle_seal_effect are Fates' own). Facts and paths only. Round 85 (docs/PUBLIC_RELEASE_PLAN.md sections 4, 5 and 9): the Vanilla+ entry also leaves out the plan file, the game-picker design page, the unsent licence letter draft, the 4 dead-link Seal stubs and the 4 robot scripts that start with the owner's own folder path; 'notes' is the committed public notes file for a tag (used word for word when it exists at that commit), 'last_public_tag' the newest tag on the public repo.

marker_allowed_note: marker_allowed_paths = the frozen history docs (docs/SEAL_EDITION_PLAN.md section 2, the docs inventory's group E); marker_allowed_lines = how many lines of that file may hold a marker (the one credit line; LICENSE's rights sentence credits Laz14 too). marker_shared_by_design = files the plan keeps shared in both editions (marker_shared_why gives the plan section): reported as info, never a failure. Round 84 gate: exact paths only ('*' stays inside one folder, '**' crosses folders; only the frozen engine patches use '*'). Empty that list to make the gate strict. Every other marker fails the edition gate. A marker_allowed_lines key may be a path pattern (same '*' rule): the committed Vanilla+ notes files hold the one credit line.
